publication_type: bilingual unitary reader shell, canonical control room and controlled site search
purpose: Compress and orchestrate the existing evidence system without replacing dossier ownership, evidential status controls or primary-source records.

procedural_gateways.purpose: English routing gateway only; it prevents substitution of DIP 2/2026 or DP 1956/2026 for the distinct DP 1901/2026 record and does not replace the fuller Spanish dossier.

reader_contract: The Control Room is a cross-system reader interface, not a new source of facts.
Registered title, CEXP participation, LPB insolvency estate, material control, financing and institutional supervision remain distinct systems.
A documented gap is not culpability and silence is not treated as proof of wrongdoing.
Search results are discovery metadata; evidential status remains controlled by the canonical destination page and primary sources.
DP 1901/2026, DIP 2/2026 and DP 1956/2026 remain separate procedural references unless a primary record expressly connects them for a defined purpose.
Corrections, contrary evidence and evidence capable of defeating Por Derecho's interpretation receive visible treatment.
Existing dossier ownership and all stronger non-overclaim controls remain in force.

homepage_change.method: dynamic additive shell loaded through the already-global share-controls bridge
homepage_change.gateway: A compact Case Control Room gateway is inserted after the current-priority band.

search.mode: curated canonical route registry plus all main-sitemap routes as fallback
search.boundary: The search index supports discovery only; it does not create or upgrade evidential findings.

checks: unitary shell loads on both language homepages and representative existing dossiers
CEXP search returns a relevant controlled result
DP 1901 English routing remains distinct from DIP 2/2026 and DP 1956/2026
new routes have no duplicate IDs
tested routes do not introduce horizontal overflow
screenshots and machine-readable result are uploaded as a workflow artifact

migration_boundary.reason: The current global loader chain has mature inter-module dependencies. The consolidation shell creates a route-aware migration point without risking a one-shot dependency rewrite.
migration_boundary.next_safe_step: Migrate legacy global loaders into route bundles only after this shell regression gate is green and deployed.
